theme_central: Allah, the Originator of the heavens and the earth: His real power contrasted with the total powerlessness of false deities, and man's fundamental poverty, needing Him at every instant.
sources_note: Division into 5 rukus precisely sourced (grokipedia, studocu): 1-8, 9-14, 15-21, 22-28, 29-45.

branches.title: Creation and angel messengers
branches.resume: Allah, Originator of the heavens and the earth, the angel messengers endowed with wings.

children.t: Allah the Originator, the angel messengers; Satan is a declared enemy

branches.title: Mercy and resurrection
branches.resume: The wind, the clouds, the dead land brought back to life as an image of the resurrection.

children.t: The dead land brought back to life by rain, image of the resurrection

branches.title: Human dependence on Allah
branches.resume: Men are poor, Allah alone is self-sufficient; comparison of the blind and the seeing, the living and the dead.

children.t: Man's fundamental poverty, no one will bear another's burden
Comparison between the blind and the seeing, the shade and the scorching heat

branches.title: Messengers and signs
branches.resume: Every community had its warner; diversity of colors as a sign; only the learned truly fear Allah.

children.t: Every community had its warner before this one
Diversity of colors in creation; only the learned truly fear Allah

branches.title: Warning of the Judgment, closing
branches.resume: Those who recite the Book hope for an imperishable trade; three categories of the Book's heirs; Allah holds the heavens and the earth.

children.t: Those who recite the Book hope for a trade that will never perish
Three categories of the Book's heirs; contrast of Paradise and Hell
Allah holds the heavens and the earth; request to return refused to the disbelievers
